protocol: Real2Code-protocol test set, 37 PartNet-Mobility objects; 9 RGB-D fitting views and 3 held-out validation views per object; 8 proposals and 30 minutes per object; selection by mean validation silhouette IoU; Real2Code chamfer_distance and compute_joint_error from clone ecd50d27. No-masks and segmented-mask runs use colored renders and the current prompt; ground-truth-mask runs use the first prompt. Segmented masks come from SAM2 prompted at points on the object's surface with a fine-tuned mask decoder (datvo06/robotl-reconstruction PR #5). Matched summaries use the objects both models finished in each condition. GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 rows: segmented masks; the MuJoCo XML run writes each scene as one MJCF document with no RoboTL; Gemini 4's rows on the slide add one prompt line saying only evaluated scenes count and are labelled with it here; its standard-prompt run is kept as 'segmented masks, standard prompt'.
